evals.name: fan-out-5-independent-tasks
evals.prompt: I need to audit 5 services for security issues: auth-service, payment-service, user-service, notification-service, and gateway-service. Each has its own directory under `services/`. For each one, I need: a list of unvalidated inputs, missing auth checks, and hardcoded secrets. All five are independent — they don't depend on each other. Give me a combined audit report.

assertions.text: Creates a task spec YAML for each of the 5 services under .agent-state/tasks/
Spawns a worker per service, each with only its task spec and relevant context files
Governance does not read service source files or perform per-unit audit work itself
Collects short confirmations from workers without reading result files into context
Spawns a fresh synthesis agent to read all .agent-state/results/*.yaml and produce the combined report

evals.name: serialize-dependent-tasks
evals.prompt: I have two tasks: (1) generate database migration files for a new `audit_log` table, and (2) write the ORM model class that maps to that table. Task 2 depends on task 1 — the model needs the column definitions from the migration. Plan and execute this.

assertions.text: Recognizes task 2 depends on task 1 and marks task 2 with blocked_on in its task spec
Fans out task 1 (migration) first, waits for completion before spawning task 2
Does not spawn task 2 worker in parallel with task 1
Task 2 worker receives task 1's result file path in context_files, not its full output
